pr_title: Add check for `target_sizes is None` in `post_process_image_guided_detection` for owlv2

issue_context.title: `target_sizes` in Owlv2 `post_process_image_guided_detection`
issue_context.body:
### System Info

N/A

### Who can help?

_No response_

### Information

- [ ] The official example scripts
- [ ] My own modified scripts

### Tasks

- [ ] An officially supported task in the `examples` folder (such as GLUE/SQuAD, ...)
- [ ] My own task or dataset (give details below)

### Reproduction

In `post_process_image_guided_detection` ([link](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/blob/main/src/transformers/models/owlv2/image_processing_owlv2.py#L544C9-L544C44)), there's no check for when `target_sizes = None`, so calling it without providing `target_sizes` raises an error.

### Expected behavior

The case where `target_sizes` is `None` should be handled, as done in `post_process_detection` ([link](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/blob/main/src/transformers/models/owlv2/image_processing_owlv2.py#L484))
comments: Hi @catalys1, thanks for raising! Would you like to open a PR to address this? This way you get the github contribution for spotting the error and the fix

review_comments: if `target_sizes` is `None` we still need to set img_h, img_w
I thought if `target_sizes` is `None`, then we don't scale the bounding boxes, we leave them in relative coordinates. In which case, we don't need to go anything related to scaling.
Right, but the line on L589 expects the img_w and img_h variables, which will now error out as they're undefined if target_sizes is None. I suspect L598 and L599 should also be indented
Yes, they should be inside the if block. That's my mistake.
